Hi all — reviewed.

Summary (short):
- Temporary processor: MapleInsight Inc. (Canada) — analytics-only contract, 30-day pilot, limited to hashed identifiers and aggregated telemetry.
- Export profile: No intentional EU export. The data path is: FinExport -> Redwood hosted (us-east) -> MapleInsight (Canada). MappleInsight will not receive raw PII; telemetry is pseudonymized. Observability logs are scrubbed; no KV cache is shared.
- Required docs: We recommend a narrow DPA addendum (annex) to enumerate scope and retention (45-day retention cap) and that MapleInsight's SOC2 Type II evidence be attached.

Attachments: subprocessor_snapshot.csv (includes MapleInsight entry) and export_profile_v2.pdf (processed flow map). Also attached is a draft dpa_addendum_draft.docx for your review.

Procurement note: expected incremental cost is low (one-off onboarding fee + per-hour analytics). I'll send a short estimate once procurement confirms usage volume.

Kimberly Park

Redwood Inference
